en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with two tall western towers, viewed from across a series of cascading pools and fountains in a formal park. Trees frame the building and small figures walk on the steps leading up to the church. At the bottom of the image, printed captions in Hungarian read "Pécs" on the left and "Székesegyház" on the right. The reverse side contains handwritten Hungarian text in blue ink, address lines, a partial circular postmark, a missing stamp area, a small publisher logo reading "L. F. WEINSTOCK" and a printed serial number "3268/17. sz."
